description: Updates a Stripe PaymentIntent with new values for specified parameters; note that if `currency` is updated, `amount` might also be required, and certain updates (e.g., to `payment_method`) can necessitate re-confirmation by the customer.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating a payment intent.

amount.description: The amount intended to be collected by this PaymentIntent, in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for USD). This is a positive integer.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: The three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase (e.g., 'usd', 'eur'). Must be a supported currency.
currency.title: Currency

customer.description: The ID of the Customer this PaymentIntent should be associated with.
customer.title: Customer

description.description: An arbitrary string providing a description of the PaymentIntent, often displayed to users.
description.title: Description

metadata.description: A set of key-value pairs to store additional structured information about the PaymentIntent. Keys can be up to 40 characters long and values can be up to 500 characters long.
metadata.title: Metadata

payment_intent_id.description: The unique identifier of the PaymentIntent to be updated.
payment_intent_id.title: Payment Intent Id

payment_method.description: ID of the PaymentMethod to attach to this PaymentIntent.
payment_method.title: Payment Method

receipt_email.description: The email address to which Stripe will send a receipt for a successful payment.
receipt_email.title: Receipt Email

setup_future_usage.description: Indicates if you intend to use the payment method attached to this PaymentIntent for future payments. Allowed values are 'on_session' or 'off_session'.
setup_future_usage.title: Setup Future Usage

statement_descriptor.description: String for customer's credit card statement (max 22 characters).
statement_descriptor.title: Statement Descriptor

statement_descriptor_suffix.description: Additional info for customer's card statement, appended to `statement_descriptor` (max 22 characters).
statement_descriptor_suffix.title: Statement Descriptor Suffix
